source.content: global class G4CacheBuilder implements Cache.CacheBuilder { global Object doLoad(String key) { return 'loaded:' + key; } }

@isTest private class G4CacheDeterministicEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { System.assertEquals('local.default.key', Cache.OrgPartition.createFullyQualifiedKey('local', 'default', 'key')); System.assertEquals('local.default', Cache.OrgPartition.createFullyQualifiedPartition('local', 'default')); Cache.OrgPartition.validatePartitionName('default'); Cache.OrgPartition.validateKey(false, 'key'); Cache.OrgPartition.validateKeyValue(false, 'key', 'value'); System.assertEquals('local.default.key', Cache.Partition.createFullyQualifiedKey('local', 'default', 'key')); System.assertEquals('local.default', Cache.Partition.createFullyQualifiedPartition('local', 'default')); Cache.Partition.validatePartitionName('default'); Cache.Partition.validateKey(false, 'key'); Cache.Partition.validateKeyValue(false, 'key', 'value'); System.assertEquals('local.default.key', Cache.SessionPartition.createFullyQualifiedKey('local', 'default', 'key')); System.assertEquals('local.default', Cache.SessionPartition.createFullyQualifiedPartition('local', 'default')); Cache.SessionPartition.validatePartitionName('default'); Cache.SessionPartition.validateKey(false, 'key'); Cache.SessionPartition.validateKeyValue(false, 'key', 'value'); System.assertEquals('loaded:org-key', (String)Cache.Org.get(G4CacheBuilder.class, 'org-key')); System.assertEquals(true, Cache.Org.remove(G4CacheBuilder.class, 'org-key')); System.assertEquals('loaded:session-key', (String)Cache.Session.get(G4CacheBuilder.class, 'session-key')); System.assertEquals(true, Cache.Session.remove(G4CacheBuilder.class, 'session-key')); } }
